title: Wrocław Dialogue Corpus (WroDiaCo), current v2.1 lineage
why_promising: Primary non-singing L2 German production by native Polish speakers, covering task-free spontaneous dialogue, task-based dialogue and read word lists. Published corpus documentation describes time-aligned Praat annotation layers and, critically, a manually corrected phone-segmentation layer (KORphon) distinct from WebMAUS-generated SAMPword/phon tiers; this makes the corrected layer potentially eligible while the automatic precursor tiers remain excluded. Version 2 documentation reports 8 sessions / 16 participants, and the HU media repository lists a newer v2.1 corpus lineage.
open_question: Full corpus access is controlled for scientific use via account/download-link request rather than an unrestricted public file endpoint. Before promotion, obtain/inspect v2.1 file-level metadata and license terms, verify that KORphon (and any other eligible layers) remain manually corrected in v2.1, enumerate TextGrid/audio files and checksums, isolate human-corrected tiers from automatic WebMAUS tiers, and deduplicate v1/v2/v2.1 as one evolving recording lineage.
